docs.source_snippet_binding: Each intended diagnostic must join the exact documented code and authenticated source owner. Compiler refusal for an unrelated reason does not pass. Preserve complete stdout/stderr and ordinary matching-library prebind.

forbidden: No retries, skipped case, filter, ignore or substituted refusal
No stderr omission, extra panic or backtrace suppression by changing the request
No cap increase or cold-docs claim
No source or assertion change to make expected captures match

environment_preconditions: No RUST_TEST_SHUFFLE, RUST_TEST_SHUFFLE_SEED or test filters
One unfiltered invocation, test-threads=1, nocapture, no color/format override
No panic-hook replacement; exact approved source and admitted compiler/runtime profile

G10_OS_THREAD_ID.attribution: Named g10 test thread; observed decimal OS thread identifier, not an invented constant.

TLS_OS_THREAD_ID.attribution: Unnamed spawned P3 worker; observed decimal OS thread identifier. No distinctness or non-reuse claim across completed threads.

ELAPSED_SECONDS.constraint: Finite nonnegative seconds rendered with exactly two decimal digits; only this elapsed field may vary.
